description: Project scaffold plus the foundation layer every other feature depends on: package.json (pinned deps + scripts), strict tsconfig.json, the .gitignore fix, and the core modules with no PM2/HTTP dependency — logger, shared types, typed event emitter, config loaders (env + alert rules), error signature + tracker, metrics store, and the MonitorState hub. This feature is independent of FEAT-002..005 and is the base they build on. Grounded in design.md sections: On-disk project layout, Core data model, Config loader, Error tracker, Metrics store, module boundaries, and the Round-3 MEDIUM-1/MEDIUM-2 resolutions.
steps: Create package.json with scripts build="tsc", start="node dist/index.js", dev="tsx watch src/index.ts", typecheck="tsc --noEmit", test="tsx --test \"src/**/*.test.ts\"", lint="tsc --noEmit"; engines.node ">=20"; EXACT pinned deps (no ^/~): dependencies express 4.22.3, ws 8.22.0, pm2 5.4.3, nodemailer 6.10.1, dotenv 16.6.1, zod 3.25.76; devDependencies typescript 5.9.3, tsx 4.23.15, @types/node 20.19.43, @types/express 4.17.25, @types/ws 8.18.2, @types/nodemailer 6.4.24. (MS Teams uses global fetch — no HTTP-client dep.)

Create tsconfig.json: strict true, target ES2022, module NodeNext, moduleResolution NodeNext, outDir dist, rootDir src, esModuleInterop, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames, skipLibCheck, resolveJsonModule, types ["node"], include ["src"]. Note: NodeNext requires relative imports in src to carry explicit .js extensions.
Update .gitignore: add two explicit lines `.env` and `logs/` (do not rely on the existing *.log). Keep existing node_modules/ and dist/ entries.

src/core/logger.ts: structured JSON logger with debug/info/warn/error gated by LOG_LEVEL, child loggers, a redaction set (API_KEY, BASIC_PASS, SMTP_PASS, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL -> ***), a shared redactUrl(url) that rewrites token=... -> token=***, and a rate-limited warnOnce/throttle helper. Add src/core/logger.test.ts (level gating, redaction, redactUrl).

src/core/types.ts: ProcStatus, ProcessSnapshot, MetricSample, LogLine (stream out|err, level info|error derived from stream, line, ts), TrackedError (incl optional intentional for restart level), MonitorSnapshot — exactly per design Core data model. src/core/events.ts: a typed MonitorEvents EventEmitter carrying state:update, process:transition, pm2:connected, pm2:disconnected, metrics:tick (ProcessSnapshot[]), error:captured, log:line, alert.

src/config/env.ts: loadConfig(): AppConfig runs dotenv.config(), parses process.env via a zod schema covering EVERY env var in the design config table (PORT, HOST, AUTH_MODE, API_KEY, BASIC_USER/PASS, SMTP_*, MAIL_FROM/TO, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL, ALERT_RULES_FILE, METRICS_RETENTION_MIN, METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC, ERROR_BUFFER_SIZE, ERROR_LOG_APPEND, DEFAULT_COOLDOWN_SEC, INTENTIONAL_ACTION_GRACE_MS, ALLOWED_SCRIPT_ROOT, DIGEST_ENABLED, DIGEST_HOUR, LOG_LEVEL) with coercion/defaults and cross-field refinements (AUTH_MODE=basic requires BASIC_USER+BASIC_PASS; channel groups). Fail fast: log aggregated zod issues and process.exit(1) on invalid env. Freeze the returned config. Add src/config/env.test.ts (valid/invalid/refinement cases — test the schema/parse function directly so it does not call process.exit in tests).

src/config/alertRules.ts: define alertRuleSchema as a zod object whose match.condition is a discriminatedUnion('type',[...]) over the five variants (errored, unexpected-stop, restart-threshold{count,withinMin}, cpu-threshold{percent,forSec}, mem-threshold{bytes,forSec}, error-spike{count,withinSec}); id regex ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$, positive-int thresholds, channels require >=1 true, processes entries "*" or valid name; strict objects. export type AlertRule = z.infer<typeof alertRuleSchema>. loadAlertRules(path): AlertRule[] — missing file => [] + warn once; invalid file => log issues + exit(1). Add src/config/alertRules.test.ts.

src/errors/signature.ts: pure signature(processName, text): string per the 5-step algorithm (first stack frame via /at .+ \(?(.+):\d+:\d+\)?/ or first non-empty line; normalize abs paths->basenames, :line:col->:*, long hex /\b[0-9a-f]{8,}\b/ and number runs /\d{3,}/ -> #, collapse whitespace, lowercase; prepend process name; sha1 first 16 hex). Add src/errors/signature.test.ts (same error varying ts/pid/line -> one signature; distinct errors -> distinct).

src/errors/tracker.ts: ErrorTracker subscribing to error:captured; per-process Map<signature,TrackedError> with dedup (increment count/lastSeen) and a per-process ring buffer capacity ERROR_BUFFER_SIZE (evict oldest). Two 1-second-slot rings per process (errors ring; crash-loop restart ring) sized to max window any loaded rule requests (max(error-spike withinSec, restart-threshold withinMin*60), 60s floor), recomputable/resizable via a setMaxWindow(sec) call used on load and reload (grow=zero-fill, shrink=discard). Expose countInWindow(name,sinceSec) and restartsInWindow(name,sinceSec) summing trailing slots; defensive clamp+warnOnce if sinceSec>ringLength. Restart ring increments ONLY on error:captured level restart with intentional===false (not restart overlimit, not operator restarts). Best-effort append each raw captured error as one JSON line to logs/errors.log when ERROR_LOG_APPEND (warn on write failure, never throw). Add src/errors/tracker.test.ts (dedup, eviction, window sums, resize grow/shrink, restart-ring exclusions, injected clock).

src/metrics/store.ts: MetricsStore per-process ring of MetricSample, capacity ceil(METRICS_RETENTION_MIN*60/METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC); push(name,sample) evicting expired/overflow; getSeries(name,sinceMs) (internal — reached only via the hub). sustainedAbove(name, metric:'cpu'|'mem', threshold, durationSec): compute sampleSec=METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC, expected=ceil(durationSec/sampleSec), required=max(1,expected-1); collect in-window samples; return false if fewer than required OR any adjacent gap > 2*sampleSec (fail-safe); else true iff every collected sample's metric > threshold. Injectable clock. Add src/metrics/store.test.ts (under-coverage->false, gap->false, steady-state arms within one window, eviction, true/false threshold cases).

src/core/state.ts: MonitorState owns Map<string,ProcessSnapshot> (name-keyed aggregate), the owned MetricsStore and ErrorTracker, pm2Connected bool, maintenance {active,until?,reason?}, and the MonitorEvents ref. Read methods snapshot(), getProcess(name), getMetrics(name,sinceMs) delegating to the owned MetricsStore.getSeries (the ONLY public series read). Mutations applyPm2List(list), setConnected(bool), setMaintenance({active,durationMin?,reason?}) emitting the right events; lazy maintenance expiry on read. Subscribe to metrics:tick: for each snapshot push a MetricSample {ts:snap.lastUpdated,cpu:snap.cpu,mem:snap.memory} only when status==='online' (skip others, no sample), and prune MetricsStore series for names no longer in the snapshot map. Add src/core/state.test.ts.
Add a minimal src/index.ts stub (e.g. a comment + empty bootstrap export) so tsc has an entry and build succeeds; it will be fully implemented in FEAT-004.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes successfully with the exact pinned versions.
npm run build compiles with ZERO TypeScript errors under strict mode.
npm test passes for all FEAT-001 unit tests (logger, env, alertRules, signature, tracker, metrics store, state).
.gitignore contains explicit `.env` and `logs/` lines in addition to node_modules/ and dist/.

The ErrorTracker restart ring increments only on intentional===false restarts and resizes to the max rule window; MetricsStore.sustainedAbove returns false under insufficient coverage and arms within one window at steady state (verified by tests).
verification: Run: npm run build  — zero tsc strict errors.
Run: npm test  — all FEAT-001 unit tests pass.
Confirm .gitignore has `.env` and `logs/` lines (read the file).
findings:
VERIFIED: npm install ok; npm run build + npm run typecheck => 0 tsc strict errors; npm test => 58 pass / 0 fail; .gitignore has node_modules/, dist/, .env, logs/. PM2 not started.

DEVIATION (test script): context.json pinned test="tsx --test \"src/**/*.test.ts\"" but Node 20.19's native test runner does NOT expand globs itself (that is stable only in Node 21+), so the quoted glob yielded 'Could not find ...'. Fixed by UNQUOTING the glob in package.json: test="tsx --test src/**/*.test.ts" so npm's /bin/sh expands it. In sh (no globstar) ** behaves like *, i.e. src/*/*.test.ts, which matches every test file since all tests live exactly one dir deep (src/<module>/*.test.ts). If a future test is nested deeper than src/<dir>/ this script will miss it — revisit then. Other scripts: build=tsc, start=node dist/index.js, dev=tsx watch src/index.ts, typecheck/lint=tsc --noEmit.

EXACT PINNED VERSIONS npm resolved (all exact, no ^/~, matched the plan): deps express 4.22.3, ws 8.22.0, pm2 5.4.3, nodemailer 6.10.1, dotenv 16.6.1, zod 3.25.76; devDeps typescript 5.9.3, tsx 4.23.15, @types/node 20.19.43, @types/express 4.17.25, @types/ws 8.18.2, @types/nodemailer 6.4.24. npm audit reports 11 vulns (10 high,1 moderate) all transitive via pm2 5.4.3 — left as-is (versions are pinned by design).

tsconfig: ESM project (package.json "type":"module"), module/moduleResolution NodeNext => ALL relative imports in src carry explicit .js extensions. target ES2022, strict, outDir dist, rootDir src, types:[node].

EXPORTED SYMBOLS later features import:
- src/core/logger.ts: createLogger(opts?): Logger; type Logger (methods debug/info/warn/error/child/warnOnce(key,msg,ctx?)/throttle(key,windowMs?)); type LogLevel; const REDACTED_KEYS (Set: API_KEY,BASIC_PASS,SMTP_PASS,TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL); redactUrl(url)->strips token=...; interface LoggerOptions {level?,sink?,now?}.
- src/core/types.ts: types ProcStatus, ProcessSnapshot, MetricSample, LogLine, TrackedError, MonitorSnapshot (exactly per design).
- src/core/events.ts: class MonitorEvents (typed on/off/once/emit/removeAllListeners over MonitorEventMap); interfaces ProcessTransitionEvent{name,from,to,at}, LogLineEvent{process,stream,level,line,ts}, AlertEvent{payload:unknown,delivered:boolean}; MonitorEventMap keys: state:update[MonitorSnapshot], process:transition[ProcessTransitionEvent], pm2:connected[], pm2:disconnected[], metrics:tick[ProcessSnapshot[]], error:captured[TrackedError], log:line[LogLineEvent], alert[AlertEvent]. NOTE: AlertEvent.payload is typed unknown (FEAT-003 will cast to its AlertPayload); error:captured carries a TrackedError (ErrorTracker recomputes signature from processName+sample internally, so Pm2Client may emit a partial TrackedError and leave signature empty).
- src/config/env.ts: loadConfig(logger?): Readonly<AppConfig> (dotenv+parse, process.exit(1) on invalid); parseConfig(env): SafeParseReturnType (pure, test-safe, no exit); const configSchema; type AppConfig. Env fields cover the full design table (PORT,HOST,AUTH_MODE,API_KEY,BASIC_USER/PASS,SMTP_*,MAIL_FROM/TO,TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL,ALERT_RULES_FILE,METRICS_RETENTION_MIN,METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC,ERROR_BUFFER_SIZE,ERROR_LOG_APPEND,DEFAULT_COOLDOWN_SEC,INTENTIONAL_ACTION_GRACE_MS,ALLOWED_SCRIPT_ROOT,DIGEST_ENABLED,DIGEST_HOUR,LOG_LEVEL) with defaults + refinements (apikey=>API_KEY, basic=>BASIC_USER+BASIC_PASS, email group all-or-nothing). MAIL_TO stays a raw comma string (FEAT-003 splits it).
- src/config/alertRules.ts: const alertRuleSchema (strict; condition is z.discriminatedUnion('type',[errored|unexpected-stop|restart-threshold{count,withinMin}|cpu-threshold{percent,forSec}|mem-threshold{bytes,forSec}|error-spike{count,withinSec}]); id ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$; defaults enabled=true,severity=warning,processes=['*']); const conditionSchema; const alertRulesFileSchema ({rules:[]}); type AlertRule = z.infer<typeof alertRuleSchema>; loadAlertRules(path,logger?): AlertRule[] (missing=>[]+warnOnce, invalid/bad-json=>exit1).
- src/errors/signature.ts: signature(processName, text): string (pure, 16 hex chars, sha1).
- src/errors/tracker.ts: class ErrorTracker; ErrorTrackerOptions{events,bufferSize,logAppend,logFile?,logger?,now?}; methods: subscribes to error:captured in ctor; setMaxWindow(sec) (floor 60s, resize both rings grow=zerofill/shrink=discard; call on load+reload with max(error-spike withinSec, restart-threshold withinMin*60)); countInWindow(name,sinceSec); restartsInWindow(name,sinceSec) (restart ring increments ONLY on level 'restart' && intentional===false); list(name): TrackedError[]; drop(name); stop(). Internal SlotRing is timestamp-stamped (stale slots read 0). Appends raw JSON lines to logs/errors.log only when logAppend, best-effort (warnOnce on failure, never throws).
- src/metrics/store.ts: class MetricsStore; MetricsStoreOptions{retentionMin,sampleSec,now?}; capacity=ceil(retentionMin*60/sampleSec); push(name,sample); getSeries(name,sinceMs) (INTERNAL hub boundary — reach via MonitorState.getMetrics only); sustainedAbove(name,'cpu'|'mem',threshold,durationSec) (required=max(1,ceil(dur/sampleSec)-1); false if under-covered or adjacent gap>2*sampleSec; else every sample>threshold); drop(name); names(). metric selector indexes MetricSample (cpu/mem), not ProcessSnapshot.memory.
- src/core/state.ts: class MonitorState; MonitorStateOptions{events,metrics,errors,now?}; interfaces MaintenanceState{active,until?,reason?}, SetMaintenanceInput{active,durationMin?,reason?}; reads snapshot(), getProcess(name), getMetrics(name,sinceMs) (ONLY public series read, delegates to MetricsStore.getSeries), isConnected(), getMaintenance() (lazy expiry); mutations applyPm2List(list) (emits process:transition on status change + state:update; removes names absent from list), setConnected(bool) (emits pm2:connected/disconnected + state:update), setMaintenance(input) (emits state:update); subscribes to metrics:tick -> pushes MetricSample {ts:snap.lastUpdated,cpu:snap.cpu,mem:snap.memory} ONLY when status==='online', and prunes MetricsStore series for names absent from the tick (deleted-process cleanup); stop(). static STATUSES.
- src/index.ts: STUB exporting async bootstrap(): Promise<void> (no-op) — FEAT-004 implements the real boot/shutdown.

TEST INFRA: node:test + node:assert, run via tsx. Fakes/clocks injected via each class's now? option; MonitorEvents used directly as the bus in tests. No src/testutil/ created yet (none needed by FEAT-001).
